title: Western Star 4800/4900 FUPS compliant Custom Built Road Train Bullbar #1
description: Western Star hi-tensile aluminium polished FUPS Bullbar for 4800/4900 series. Five post design. Tow plate cover is black but other finishes available or chrome plated. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs, cow catcher with three small uprights. Built with 88mm diameter pipe. Custom driving light mounts as required, bar mounted indicator repeater light. Front mudflap bar standard.
